decision_rule.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (CELL-1 minus PLAN) is ABOVE ZERO and the CI95 lower bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -0.9943 (owner decision 99, the TRAIN lock: a gain is proven, not merely non-inferior)
decision_rule.DELTA_CONSUMPTION: item S3-4s: the per-node delta-consumption table -- how many deltas each node was supplied per row, which value_ids were supplied, and the saves and harms on the rows that received each one -- is a PRIMARY deliverable, reported whatever the verdict, and is what decides which deltas survive into store version 2.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows) is reported on every verdict and placed beside the registered rows.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: a MEASURED loss on either guard (owner decision 25, Method B: a CI95 upper bound below zero, or a point estimate beyond the margin); width alone is NEUTRAL, never HARMFUL
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: both guards are non-inferior -- the SLU CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.2485 and the intent CI95 lower bound exceeds -0.9943 -- without a proven SLU gain
decision_rule.PER_SCENARIO_HARM_BOUND: owner decision 17: per-scenario intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, with net harmed rows per scenario and any scenario of five or more flagged. A breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate.
decision_rule.REPLICATION: an ADMITTED result is replicated on the SAME roster before any DEV, Fold B or test read (the owner iteration rule; no DEV read is authorised by this package).
decision_rule.TWIN: ATTRIBUTION, never admission. The twin arm is read with the same estimator against the same sealed PLAN comparator. A gain the twin reproduces within the plan's own null is FORM (the store's shape and token volume), not content, and the verdict says so and claims no content effect. A gain the twin does not reproduce is attributed to the deltas' content, with the twin delta reported beside it.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 (official 63.6304 / 82.2222); nothing is re-flown
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict
